subject: OTLP connectivity & certs: joint integration runbook and timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OTLP connectivity & certs: joint integration runbook and timeline

Hi all —

Thanks for agreeing to sync on the multi-vendor observability integration. Our goal for this thread is to lock down the technical runbook and a short pilot timeline so we can give customers a concise integration checklist (Datadog + OTLP + Grafana). Specific asks:

- Confirm necessary TLS/MTLS certificate requirements (rotation window, accepted CAs) for Datadog ingestion endpoints.
- Agree on the OTLP protocol variants we should support out-of-the-box (grpc/http/protobuf versions).
- Identify any Grafana datasource constraints (panel latency expectations, datasource caching) that change our mapping.
- Tentative pilot window: Oct 4–15 (2 weeks). Can Datadog/Grafana commit an SME availability?

I've attached a short checklist and a draft runbook (see attachments). Marissa — can you own commercial-facing docs once we have the final checklist? Vanessa — can you coordinate marketplace listing notes? Hiro — fyi on cert rotation questions below.

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0198

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@datadog.com>

Cc: Lars Nilsen <lars@grafana.com>, OpenTelemetry Maintainers <otlp-eng@opentelemetry.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OTLP connectivity & certs: joint integration runbook and timeline

Jordan — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers from Datadog side:

- TLS: We support TLS 1.2+ for ingestion; for mutual TLS we require client certs only for private endpoints (we can open a private ingestion endpoint for pilot). Our cert rotation cadence is 90 days by default; we can extend to 180 days for pilot but prefer 90 for security. Accepted CA list: LetsEncrypt, DigiCert, GlobalSign.
- OTLP: We can accept OTLP/gRPC (recommended) and OTLP/HTTP (measurement mode). For trace spans protobuf v0.17+ is preferred.
- SME availability: Samira (me) + one infra engineer (TBD) available Oct 5–9 for the initial setup.

I'll review the checklist and add Datadog-side configuration snippets by Friday.

—Samira
Samira Khan
Partner Integrations, Datadog
samira.khan@datadog.com

Subject: Re: OTLP connectivity & certs: joint integration runbook and timeline

Forwarding a short technical note from infra after a quick scan — added inline to the runbook.

Key points:
- Our OTLP collector supports gRPC and HTTP; gRPC better preserves context and reduces overhead. We'll default to gRPC in the starter config.
- For mutual TLS we need the CA chain and expected SANs for client certs. Datadog: please provide the CA bundle and an example cert thumbprint you expect.
- Cert rotation: we can automate via Vault PKI; recommend rotation window of 90 days to match Datadog. We should also include a recovery playbook: keep a standby keypair, and test rotation in staging 7 days before production cutover.

I've attached a short snippet (otlp-cert-reqs.md) with config examples. If Datadog can share the API for private endpoint provisioning we'll script the provisioning step.

Hiro

1) Pilot dates confirmed: Oct 5–12 (we'll keep Oct 13–15 as buffer). Datadog SME (Samira + infra) available Oct 5–9.
2) Auth model: target = mTLS for private ingestion endpoint; API-key fallback only for public ingestion / troubleshooting. Datadog to share CA bundle + example cert thumbprint by Sept 22.
3) Redwood infra (Hiro) will script Vault-driven rotation (90-day cadence) and send a staging rotation run on Sept 28.
4) CloudBridge to provide PoC collector config by Sept 24.
5) Marissa/Vanessa owner actions: marketplace one-pager + customer-facing checklist due Sept 28.

I've updated the Drive doc and attached the runbook checklist. Please reply only if there are blockers; otherwise we'll proceed to the deliverable dates above.

Thanks,
Jordan
